sentence: I apologize for being late.
zh-TW: 很抱歉我遲到了。

sentence: We need the manager's approval first.
zh-TW: 我們得先取得經理的批准。

sentence: Grab the handle so you don't fall.
zh-TW: 抓好把手，才不會跌倒。

sentence: Members are entitled to a free drink.
zh-TW: 會員可以免費享用一杯飲料。
tagging_notes: entitle 在此為「使有權享有」

sentence: Could you lend me your umbrella?
zh-TW: 你可以借我雨傘嗎？

sentence: Thanks for your involvement in the project.
zh-TW: 謝謝你參與這個專案。

sentence: Too much sun exposure is bad for your skin.
zh-TW: 曬太多太陽對皮膚不好。

sentence: Her ideas aren't very conventional.
zh-TW: 她的想法不太傳統。

sentence: Do you have a digital copy of the ticket?
zh-TW: 你有這張票的電子檔嗎？

sentence: Can you translate this sign for me?
zh-TW: 你可以幫我翻譯這個標示嗎？

sentence: I need to edit this video tonight.
zh-TW: 我今晚得剪輯這支影片。

sentence: We're discussing the formation of a new team.
zh-TW: 我們正在討論成立新團隊的事。

sentence: I'd like to make a deposit, please.
zh-TW: 我想要存款，麻煩你。

sentence: We had a pleasant evening together.
zh-TW: 我們一起度過了愉快的夜晚。

sentence: We get a lot of overseas visitors.
zh-TW: 我們有很多海外遊客。

sentence: Our teacher advocates reading every day.
zh-TW: 我們老師提倡每天閱讀。

sentence: This establishment does not allow smoking.
zh-TW: 本店禁止吸菸。

sentence: Please send me a short summary of the meeting.
zh-TW: 請寄給我一份簡短的會議摘要。

sentence: My hands feel rough from washing dishes.
zh-TW: 洗碗洗到我的手摸起來很粗糙。

sentence: May I borrow your pen?
zh-TW: 我可以借你的筆嗎？

sentence: I wish you a quick recovery.
zh-TW: 祝你早日康復。

sentence: Please seal the envelope before mailing it.
zh-TW: 寄出前請把信封封好。

sentence: We need a new tube of toothpaste.
zh-TW: 我們需要買一條新牙膏。

sentence: You can see the whole city from the tower.
zh-TW: 從塔上可以看到整個城市。

sentence: How would you characterize the new boss?
zh-TW: 你會怎麼形容新老闆？

sentence: Please specify your size when ordering.
zh-TW: 訂購時請註明您的尺寸。

sentence: Do you know the exact address?
zh-TW: 你知道確切的地址嗎？

sentence: Spin the wheel to win a prize!
zh-TW: 轉動轉盤贏大獎！

sentence: I'll connect you to an operator.
zh-TW: 我幫您轉接給接線人員。
tagging_notes: operator 在此為「（電話）接線員」

sentence: Infants under two fly free.
zh-TW: 兩歲以下的嬰兒免費搭機。

sentence: The dog is digging in the garden.
zh-TW: 狗在花園裡挖土。

sentence: Just drag the file into this folder.
zh-TW: 只要把檔案拖進這個資料夾就好。

sentence: The bills are starting to mount up.
zh-TW: 帳單開始越積越多了。

sentence: Could you wrap this as a gift?
zh-TW: 可以幫我把這個包成禮物嗎？

sentence: We don't anticipate any delays.
zh-TW: 我們預計不會有任何延誤。

sentence: Our plans are dependent on the weather.
zh-TW: 我們的計畫要看天氣而定。

sentence: This shop specializes in handmade shoes.
zh-TW: 這家店專門做手工鞋。

sentence: Try taking the photo from a different angle.
zh-TW: 試著從不同角度拍這張照片。

sentence: I'll have the chicken salad.
zh-TW: 我要雞肉沙拉。

sentence: She felt a lot of anxiety before the interview.
zh-TW: 她面試前非常焦慮。

sentence: I think my computer has a virus.
zh-TW: 我覺得我的電腦中毒了。

sentence: The train left at precisely nine o'clock.
zh-TW: 火車在九點整準時開走。

sentence: The two cafes on this street are rivals.
zh-TW: 這條街上的兩家咖啡店是競爭對手。

sentence: No offense, but I don't like this color.
zh-TW: 無意冒犯，但我不喜歡這個顏色。

sentence: The alarm detects smoke right away.
zh-TW: 警報器能立刻偵測到煙霧。

sentence: My son is a teenager now.
zh-TW: 我兒子現在是青少年了。

sentence: I really admire your patience.
zh-TW: 我真的很佩服你的耐心。

sentence: The hotel has moderate prices.
zh-TW: 這間飯店價格適中。

sentence: My dad had knee surgery last month.
zh-TW: 我爸上個月動了膝蓋手術。

sentence: He's a musician in a local band.
zh-TW: 他是當地一個樂團的樂手。

sentence: What's the significance of this festival?
zh-TW: 這個節日有什麼意義？

sentence: I usually take a shower in the morning.
zh-TW: 我通常早上洗澡。

sentence: It's illegal to park here.
zh-TW: 在這裡停車是違法的。

sentence: We gave our old clothes to charity.
zh-TW: 我們把舊衣服捐給慈善機構了。

sentence: Music is a universal language.
zh-TW: 音樂是全世界共通的語言。

sentence: Please put out your cigarette.
zh-TW: 請把菸熄掉。

sentence: Women constitute half of our staff.
zh-TW: 女性佔我們員工的一半。

sentence: The hotel was adequate, but nothing special.
zh-TW: 飯店還算可以，但沒什麼特別的。
tagging_notes: adequate 在此為「還算可以、尚可」

sentence: We hired a consultant to help us.
zh-TW: 我們請了一位顧問來幫忙。

sentence: The historian gave a talk at the museum.
zh-TW: 那位歷史學家在博物館演講。

sentence: My cousin is visiting next week.
zh-TW: 我表妹下週要來玩。
tagging_notes: cousin 泛指堂／表兄弟姊妹

sentence: I'm a visual learner.
zh-TW: 我是視覺型學習者。

sentence: I made a stupid mistake.
zh-TW: 我犯了一個很蠢的錯。

sentence: She's keen on learning Japanese.
zh-TW: 她很熱衷學日文。

sentence: This city has many ethnic restaurants.
zh-TW: 這個城市有很多異國料理餐廳。
tagging_notes: ethnic 在此為「具民族特色的」

sentence: Lisa has a twin brother.
zh-TW: Lisa 有一個雙胞胎兄弟。

sentence: She works in clinical research.
zh-TW: 她從事臨床研究。

sentence: The hotel is in the eastern part of the city.
zh-TW: 飯店在城市的東區。

sentence: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
zh-TW: 天氣預報說明天會下雨。

sentence: Divide the orange into segments.
zh-TW: 把柳橙剝成一瓣一瓣。

sentence: It's a custom here to take off your shoes.
zh-TW: 這裡的習俗是要脫鞋。

sentence: It took me a while to adapt to the new job.
zh-TW: 我花了一段時間才適應新工作。

sentence: The sand is too hot to walk on.
zh-TW: 沙子燙到沒辦法走。

sentence: Don't forget your cap; it's sunny today.
zh-TW: 別忘了帶帽子，今天出大太陽。

sentence: Follow the prompts on the screen.
zh-TW: 請依照螢幕上的提示操作。

sentence: The old town has a lot of charm.
zh-TW: 這個老城區很有魅力。

sentence: How did she react to the news?
zh-TW: 她聽到消息後有什麼反應？

sentence: The lecture starts at ten.
zh-TW: 講座十點開始。
tagging_notes: lecture 在此為「講座、課堂講課」

sentence: We didn't venture outside during the storm.
zh-TW: 暴風雨期間我們不敢冒險出門。
tagging_notes: venture 在此為動詞「冒險前往」

sentence: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
zh-TW: 水是氫和氧的化合物。

sentence: Firefighters rescued the cat from the tree.
zh-TW: 消防員把貓從樹上救下來。

sentence: Sorry about the mess.
zh-TW: 抱歉，這裡很亂。

sentence: Do you have a seat preference?
zh-TW: 您對座位有偏好嗎？

sentence: This book is a comprehensive guide to the city.
zh-TW: 這本書是這座城市的完整指南。
tagging_notes: comprehensive 在此為「完整全面的」

sentence: The company offers incentives for good work.
zh-TW: 公司會提供獎勵給表現好的員工。

sentence: Our team is at the top of the league.
zh-TW: 我們隊在聯賽中排名第一。

sentence: Listen to the dialog and answer the questions.
zh-TW: 聽這段對話，然後回答問題。

sentence: Do you take cream in your coffee?
zh-TW: 你的咖啡要加奶精嗎？
tagging_notes: cream 在此為「奶精、鮮奶油」

sentence: The city has seen rapid growth.
zh-TW: 這座城市發展得很快。

sentence: I need to cancel my reservation.
zh-TW: 我需要取消我的預約。

sentence: I regret not studying harder.
zh-TW: 我後悔當初沒有更用功讀書。

sentence: He was dismissed for being late too often.
zh-TW: 他因為太常遲到被解雇了。

sentence: The profit margin on this product is small.
zh-TW: 這個產品的利潤率很低。

sentence: The cat is sleeping beneath the table.
zh-TW: 貓在桌子底下睡覺。

sentence: Her opponent was much taller.
zh-TW: 她的對手高很多。

sentence: I couldn't resist buying the cake.
zh-TW: 我忍不住買了那個蛋糕。

sentence: We don't have the capability to print in color.
zh-TW: 我們沒辦法彩色列印。

sentence: It was an absolute disaster.
zh-TW: 那簡直是一場災難。
tagging_notes: absolute 在此為「完全的、十足的」

sentence: The numbers on the map correspond to the photos.
zh-TW: 地圖上的數字對應那些照片。

sentence: My grandfather had a stroke last year.
zh-TW: 我爺爺去年中風了。
